title: Regional carrier stopped posting delivery scans

source.ref: Authored by the Precedent team from common merchant-operations practice. Not a real incident.

narrative: Item-not-received disputes rose sharply over ten days. Almost all were on one regional carrier whose tracking pages stopped showing delivery scans. Orders left the warehouse on time.

outcome.summary: Illustrative: with tracking submitted as evidence and delivery confirmation required on that carrier, new disputes on it slowed. No measured numbers.

title: High-value parcels lost on one carrier's last mile

source.ref: Authored by the Precedent team. Not a real incident.

narrative: Disputes clustered on one premium SKU shipped by one carrier. Tracking showed 'out for delivery' with no final scan. The merchant had no signature requirement.

outcome.summary: Illustrative: signature confirmation on orders above a value threshold plus tracking evidence on open disputes. No measured numbers.

title: Carrier hub outage stranded one lane

source.ref: Authored by the Precedent team. Not a real incident.

narrative: A sorting hub of one carrier went down. Parcels on that carrier stalled for days while other carriers were normal.

outcome.summary: Illustrative: new orders were routed to another carrier and affected buyers got a status message. No measured numbers.

title: Wrong tracking numbers uploaded for one carrier

source.ref: Authored by the Precedent team. Not a real incident.

narrative: An integration change sent malformed tracking numbers for one carrier. Buyers could not track parcels and opened item-not-received disputes, though most parcels arrived.

outcome.summary: Illustrative: corrected tracking was sent to buyers and attached as evidence. No measured numbers.

title: One carrier overloaded in peak season

source.ref: Authored by the Precedent team. Not a real incident.

narrative: During a holiday peak one carrier's delivery times doubled. Disputes rose on that carrier only.

outcome.summary: Illustrative: volume was shifted to a second carrier and tracking evidence was filed on open disputes. No measured numbers.

title: Carrier could not deliver to PO boxes

source.ref: Authored by the Precedent team. Not a real incident.

narrative: A new carrier contract did not cover PO-box addresses. Those parcels were returned to sender while buyers waited.

outcome.summary: Illustrative: address validation at checkout and messages to affected buyers. No measured numbers.

title: Warehouse backlog delayed all carriers

source.ref: Authored by the Precedent team. Not a real incident.

narrative: A staffing gap at the warehouse pushed ship times from one day to nearly three. Disputes rose across every carrier because parcels left late, not because carriers failed.
diagnosis: Fulfilment delay before hand-off to carriers

outcome.summary: Illustrative: backlog cleared, pick-and-pack priority changed, and buyers with late orders got proactive updates. No measured numbers.

title: Pre-order items shipped weeks later without notice

source.ref: Authored by the Precedent team. Not a real incident.

narrative: Back-ordered items were sold as in stock. Buyers waited weeks with no update and disputed across all carriers.
diagnosis: Fulfilment delay before hand-off to carriers

outcome.summary: Illustrative: buyers with delayed orders were messaged with a ship date and an option to cancel; listings were marked as pre-order. No measured numbers.

title: Migration to a new fulfilment partner

source.ref: Authored by the Precedent team. Not a real incident.

narrative: During a switch to a new third-party warehouse, orders sat unshipped for days and order-status emails stopped.
diagnosis: Fulfilment delay before hand-off to carriers

outcome.summary: Illustrative: a daily unshipped-order report and restored status emails. No measured numbers.

title: Flash sale overwhelmed packing capacity

source.ref: Authored by the Precedent team. Not a real incident.

narrative: A viral promotion tripled orders overnight. Packing fell days behind and buyers disputed before parcels shipped.
diagnosis: Fulfilment delay before hand-off to carriers

outcome.summary: Illustrative: proactive delay notices with a new ship date, and temporary order caps. No measured numbers.

title: Inventory sync bug oversold stock

source.ref: Authored by the Precedent team. Not a real incident.

narrative: Stock levels stopped syncing between channels. Orders were taken for items not on hand and waited for restock.
diagnosis: Fulfilment delay before hand-off to carriers

outcome.summary: Illustrative: sync fixed, unfulfillable orders offered a refund or a wait. No measured numbers.

title: Cross-border parcels held at customs

source.ref: Authored by the Precedent team. Not a real incident.

narrative: A change in import rules held parcels at customs across several carriers. Buyers saw no movement for days.
diagnosis: Delay outside the carrier's last mile

outcome.summary: Illustrative: messages explaining the hold, with customs status attached as evidence. No measured numbers.

title: Disputes on parcels marked delivered

source.ref: Authored by the Precedent team. Not a real incident.

narrative: Most disputed orders showed a confirmed delivery scan with GPS location. Shipping was on time and spread across carriers.
diagnosis: Disputes on orders with confirmed delivery

outcome.summary: Illustrative: proof of delivery (scan, location, photo) was filed on each dispute. No measured numbers.

title: Repeat buyers disputing delivered orders

source.ref: Authored by the Precedent team. Not a real incident.

narrative: A small group of buyer accounts disputed several delivered orders each. Delivery was confirmed with signatures in many cases.
diagnosis: Disputes on orders with confirmed delivery

outcome.summary: Illustrative: signature proof filed on disputes and the accounts flagged for review. No measured numbers.

title: Checkout autofill sent parcels to old addresses

source.ref: Authored by the Precedent team. Not a real incident.

diagnosis: Disputes on orders with confirmed delivery

outcome.summary: Illustrative: delivery proof filed, buyers messaged to resolve address errors, checkout fixed. No measured numbers.

title: Apartment mailroom misplacement

source.ref: Authored by the Precedent team. Not a real incident.

narrative: Disputed parcels were delivered to large apartment buildings and lost in shared mailrooms.
diagnosis: Disputes on orders with confirmed delivery

title: Low-value delivered orders disputed

source.ref: Authored by the Precedent team. Not a real incident.

narrative: Most disputed orders were under 15 USD and marked delivered. Fighting each one cost more staff time than the order value.
diagnosis: Disputes on orders with confirmed delivery

outcome.summary: Illustrative: partial refunds on low-value disputes, evidence on the rest. No measured numbers.

title: Delivery scans far from the buyer's address

source.ref: Authored by the Precedent team. Not a real incident.

narrative: Parcels were scanned as delivered, but the scan locations were far from buyers' addresses on one carrier's route.

outcome.summary: Illustrative: a carrier claim was filed and evidence was not submitted where scans looked wrong. No measured numbers.

source.ref: Authored by the Precedent team. Not a real incident.

narrative: Hundreds of small purchases of one cheap item from new accounts, followed by unauthorised-transaction disputes.

outcome.summary: Illustrative: velocity limits and stronger checkout checks; unwinnable claims accepted. No measured numbers.

title: Wrong size chart on a best-seller

source.ref: Authored by the Precedent team. Not a real incident.

narrative: Buyers expected new units and received refurbished ones. Disputes were not-as-described on delivered orders.
